title: feat(spec): an object declares the business order of its related lists, and 'primary' places a list
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBUwWYYvGGyzwZMhKrmvGeZR)_

Fixes #27069

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (the `relatedList` tri-state now reads as placement, plus one bullet teaching `relatedLists`) and the `relatedList: 'primary'` bullet in `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`. Both files are net smaller (token ratchet green). The field-group placement entry is not taught yet: its reader is #27055, and the layout skill text is #27059's.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:对象新增 `relatedLists`(按业务重要性排列相关列表,写子对象名或 `object.field`),字段分组新增 `relatedList`(让一个分组代表一张正文子表);`relatedList: 'primary'` 改读为"放在正文"而非排序,带 `inlineEdit` 的 `master_detail` 子表默认即 `primary`。
- 为什么改:按 2026-10-28 裁决「A」(在父对象上写有序列表),以及明细行子表放正文、可放在基本信息之下的两条裁决。
- 风险与回滚:语义变更一处——带 `inlineEdit` 且未写 `relatedList` 的明细子表,在今天的标签页布局里会升为独立标签页;写 `relatedList: true` 可保持原样。回滚 = revert 本 PR。本仓库内会变化的三个记录页:`crm_opportunity`、`showcase_invoice`、`showcase_expense_report`,各自的明细子表(`inlineEdit: 'grid'`,未写 `relatedList`)从共享 Related 标签页升为独立标签页。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts`(`resolveRelatedListOrder`、`isMainContentList`)、`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的 `collectRelatedListNameErrors`、`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` 的两个新键与 `refuseFieldsInRelatedListGroups`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack-related-lists-order.test.ts`,预期 14 个用例全绿(含 `relatedLists: ['nope']` 被拒并列出现有的入向关系)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **spec, `ObjectSchema.relatedLists?: string[]`** (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, beside `highlightFields`). Each entry is a child object name (`'task'`, every list of that child) or `object.field` for one FK (`'event.related_to'`). The entry grammar is a regex on the element (snake_case, at most one dot), so the shape is judged at parse with no new refinement node. The `.describe()` says it orders the record page's related lists by business importance, that unlisted ones follow in the derived order, and that it orders only.
- **spec, `ObjectFieldGroupSchema.relatedList?: string`**, same spelling. A group carrying it stands for that list's table in the details column. A field whose `group` names such a group is refused at parse at `fields.NAME.group` (`refuseFieldsInRelatedListGroups`, inside the object's existing `superRefine`, so no new check node for the JSON Schema projection to drop).
- **spec, strict names at `defineStack`** (`collectRelatedListNameErrors` in `stack.zod.ts`, called from `validateCrossReferences` beside `collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors`). Every `relatedLists` entry and every group `relatedList` must match an inbound `lookup` / `master_detail` field of a child (the stack's `objects`, every `packages[].manifest.objects`, and the fields their `objectExtensions` add). A miss is a `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` issue naming the entry and the inbound relationships that exist, spelled as an entry may name them. Not judged: a child only a sibling package declares (`artifactObjects`), and a platform object. Audit FKs (`created_by`, `updated_by`, `owner_id`) are not inbound relationships, matching the reader. It runs before the object-count early return, so an artifact whose objects live only in package bodies is judged too, once per object name.
- **lint, the object publish door** (`packages/lint/src/validate-related-list-refs.ts`, `validateRelatedListRefs`, rule `related-list-ref-unknown`, `error`): a new reference-integrity member on `flow` and `object` writes. It writes the sentence `defineStack` writes (a test holds the two equal), resolves the children from the snapshot's `objects` (the registry plus the stored rows) and `objectExtensions`, and refuses a child the snapshot does not hold only when no package closure is in force; under a closure that child is not judged. On the CLI an absent child is left to `defineStack`'s artifact scope. A Studio / REST `/meta` / MCP save of `relatedLists: ['nope']` is now 422 `INVALID_METADATA`.
- **lint, `validateSemanticRoles`**: rules (b) `field-group-empty` and (d) `field-group-shadowed` skip a group that carries `relatedList` (a body table holds no fields), so `os lint` no longer tells the author to assign a field the parse refuses.
- **app-shell, Studio field inspector** (main's #27163 control): `readRelatedListMode` reads the record page's own predicate (`isMainContentList`, now exported), so an inline-edited `master_detail` with no `relatedList` shows as Primary; picking the default clears the key, and Show there writes `relatedList: true`.
- **docs/adr**: ADR-0035 amended status line plus a note on the two sentences this changes (the inline-edit default, `'primary'` as placement); ADR-0085 §2 note on the keys that entered under its admission test.
- **spec, `FieldSchema.relatedList`** TSDoc and `.describe()`: `'primary'` means the record's main content (a body table; its own tab on the tabbed page) and no longer orders; absent on a `master_detail` FK that sets `inlineEdit`, the list is `'primary'` by default, and `true` keeps it a side card.
- **spec, Studio object form** (`object.form.ts`): a `relatedLists` string-tags row after `highlightFields`, and a `relatedList` sub-row in the `fieldGroups` repeater. Labels and help texts in en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES (`platform-objects` metadata-form bundles).
- **app-shell, `deriveRelatedLists.ts`**: the one resolution function `resolveRelatedListOrder(lists, declared)` replaces the plain owned-then-lookup tail. Listed lists first in the declared order (a list takes the position of the first entry naming it); unlisted ones after, in the derived order. An entry naming no list here places nothing. `isMainContentList` computes `isPrimary` with the inline-edit default. `buildDefaultTabs` is unchanged: it filters `isPrimary` into own tabs and the rest into the Related tab, both preserving this order, so "`primary` still promotes an unlisted list" holds on the tabbed page.
- **liveness**: new `object.relatedLists` row, `live` (reader `deriveRelatedLists` → `RecordDetailView`, authoring judges `collectRelatedListNameErrors` and the door rule). `object/fieldGroups` is drilled (10 child rows, the container's baseline row removed); `fieldGroups.relatedList` is `planned` (reader #27055, no `authorWarn`, since nothing warns an author about it). `field.relatedList` / `relatedListTitle` cite `RecordDetailView.tsx:1959`, with a note on the placement reading. Object shard 76 live, 1 planned.
- **generated**: authorable-surface `data.json`, `content/docs/references/**` (`gen:docs`, 4 files).
- **changeset** `.changeset/27069-related-lists-order.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@objectstack/skills`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-core`, all minor.
- **metadata-core, the served-object FLS scrub** (`object-schema-fls-references.ts`): `relatedLists` and a field group's `relatedList` are classified `keep`. They name child relationships, never a field of this object, so read as unclassified they would have over-masked an entry whose child shares a denied field's name. This is pinned against the denied-name fixture (`897e8d89`).

## Why

The maintainer's ruling (2026-10-28), verbatim, on 「元数据的开发者，可以根据业务的重要性自己指定顺序吗」 with options A (an ordered list on the parent object) / B (a number on each child FK) / C (full page only): 「A」. On a quote's line items: 「明细行的子表放在右侧合适嘛？」 → the body. On placement among the field groups: 「他如果做到放在基本信息下面，而条款和备注在后面」「如果有多个子表呢」.

On the declaration: the card said `Metadata-protocol: added`. Two keys are added, and the diff also changes what an existing value means and what an absent value defaults to: `relatedList: 'primary'` becomes placement, and an absent `relatedList` on an inline-edited `master_detail` FK now reads as `'primary'`, which on today's tabbed record page moves such a child from the shared Related tab to its own tab. That is a changed meaning and a changed default, so `semantic`, which outranks `added`. The re-reading is semantic, not only documentation: the inline-edit default is a behaviour change a reader can see without editing any metadata.

## Readers and producers (measured on `origin/main` 0f1045bc)

- Order before this PR: `deriveRelatedLists.ts` pushed `master_detail` lists, then `lookup` lists, each in registry order; `buildDefaultTabs` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`) put `isPrimary` lists into their own tabs ahead of the Related tab. Nothing else reads `relatedList` (`git grep` under `ui/`: the only branch on the value was `deriveRelatedLists.ts`).
- Where the strict-name check sits: `highlightFields`' existence check is a lint rule (`validate-object-field-refs.ts`) at the publish door and `os validate`, but it is a same-object check. A related-list name is cross-object, so it sits in `defineStack`'s `validateCrossReferences`, the cross-object refusal family with the ADR-0112 envelope.
- Pins this moves: spec `compose-stacks-merge-collection-refusal.test.ts` and `compose-stacks-collection-pipe-arm.test.ts` (the derived object collection-key list gains `relatedLists`, plus a merge-refusal row), platform-objects `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` (positive control +2, 690 → 692 on top of main) and `object-collapsed-sections-echo-decisions.test.ts` (open leaves 118 → 122).

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/stack-related-lists-order.test.ts` (14 cases): shape accepts names and `object.field`, refuses a non-array, a non-string, a non-snake and a two-dot entry; a field group with `relatedList` and no fields parses, a field naming it as its group is refused at `fields.name.group`; `defineStack` accepts child names and one FK of a child with several, refuses `nope` with `code`, a numeric `status`, one issue naming the entry and `'rlo_task', 'rlo_event.who_id', 'rlo_event.related_to'`, refuses a declared child with no FK and an unknown field, says "it has none" when there is no inbound relationship, sees an FK an `objectExtensions` entry adds, leaves a sibling-package child unjudged (and refuses it without `artifactObjects`), and judges a group's `relatedList` the same way.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/deriveRelatedLists.relatedListsOrder-27069.test.ts` (11 cases): the lead fixture's derived order; `['task', 'campaign_member']` renders tasks, campaign members, then the rest in derived order; `object.field` vs bare child name; first entry wins and an unknown entry places nothing; `relatedList: false` still hides a listed relationship; an unlisted `primary` list keeps its derived position (primary no longer orders); the inline-edit default on every arm, `true` opting out, no default without `inlineEdit` or on a `lookup`.

## Acceptance notes

- `fieldGroups[].relatedList` is declared ahead of its renderer (#27055). Until then such a group is not drawn, as every group without fields is not. It has its own liveness row, `planned`.
- The publish door judges the names (see the lint bullet). A parent written BEFORE its child exists is refused at the door (the child is nowhere); write the child's FK first, or add `relatedLists` after.
- ADR-0035 is amended in this PR (status line and note), per the contract review (`6467460418`).
- A bare child name with several FKs to the parent orders all of that child's lists (in their derived order) rather than being refused as ambiguous; `object.field` picks one.
- The reader's own drag order (target item 3) is #27055 / #27052; HotCRM's declarations (item 5) are a hotcrm follow-up.

## Verification

Final head `897e8d89a`. It is `08cebee83`, which merges `origin/main` `d745bb5e5` with no conflict, plus one fix found in CI. Test Core 4/8 went red on `08cebee83`: metadata-core's object-key classification pin (`object-schema-fls-references.test.ts`) found `relatedLists` unclassified. The fix is in `897e8d89a`. The served-object FLS scrub now keeps `relatedLists` and a group's `relatedList` as relationship names, a new test pins that against the denied-name fixture, and the changeset now names `@objectstack/metadata-core`. Every run below was under `os-verify-lock`.
